sections.heading: Sapthagiri College of Engineering vs Sir Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a placement winner. Sapthagiri has no placement row here. SVIT's latest recorded year is 2009, with average and highest recorded as zero, which we do not treat as packages.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Sapthagiri College of Engineering has recorded tuition of ₹96,500 a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the official circular and your counselling quota.
SVIT has no fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Get the college's current official notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Sapthagiri has no placement row on this page. Ask the college for its latest official placement report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: SVIT lists JEE Main on this page. Sapthagiri has no exam listed in our records here. Karnataka engineering admissions commonly also use KCET or COMEDK, depending on the college.
Confirm the current official admissions page and counselling brochure for each college.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Confirm each college's official campus city before you travel. The article pairs two engineering colleges, but you should visit the exact teaching campus named on your offer letter.
Do not assume they share a city or a commute until the official address is checked.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
